Hi Olivia — thanks for sending this over and for the kind words. I'm looping in Karthik (legal) and Lauren (sales ops) to coordinate the redline review and signature routing.

Quick answers up front:
- SCCs: We can accept standard SCCs for hosted/delegated deployments. For dedicated/private on-prem we typically add a short addendum to clarify data residency and controller/processor mapping — Karthik will confirm exact language.
- Retention: 90-day telemetry is workable; we'll flag our logging/metrics retention matrix for your security team (SOC 2 evidence attached).
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA-covered workloads under our Private offering with BAA controls. For hosted customers we can provide the controls mapping but require Dedicated/Private for full BAA commitments.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik to review and produce a Redwood redline (2 business days).
2) We exchange a single consolidated redline and agree on any exec-level exceptions.
3) Lauren will prepare signature routing (DocuSign) — please confirm who at FinCloud needs to sign and whether procurement requires a PO before signature.

Thanks — Hannah

--
